price.quote: MSRP:	$2,599 USD / $3,599 CAD ⟶ Where to Buy:	Himiway USA / Himiway Canada

cls.quote: Discover that Himiway e-bikes have the capability to operate as technically Class 3 e-bikes. While both of these bikes are shipped as Class 2 ebikes, users have the option to unlock the speed limiter, increasing the max speed to 25mph
cls.basis: Himiway's 'Unlock the Limit of the Speed' page: ships as Class 2, unlockable; its per-model unlock list includes 'D5 Pro: watch video'

spd.quote: Top speed:	20 mph / 32 kph on throttle alone, 28 mph / 45 kph with pedal assist ⟶ eBike Class:	Class 3

wh.quote: Battery: 	48V 20 Ah / 960 Wh with Samsung cells ⟶ Wheels & Tires: 	Kenda Krusade 26×4” tires on spoked rims

range.quote: Range:	Claimed 80 miles / 128 km, wBW observed 45 miles / 72 km during aggressive riding ⟶ Bike Weight:	79 lbs / 36 kg

wt.quote: Range:	Claimed 80 miles / 128 km, wBW observed 45 miles / 72 km during aggressive riding ⟶ Bike Weight:	79 lbs / 36 kg

motor.quote: Motor:	Bafang 500-watt mid-drive (they don’t specify which, but it’s probably the M560/M600) ⟶ Torque: 	130 Nm

notes: Maker regular price $2,599, on sale $1,999. Maker gives top speed only as '20+ Mph' and no class. webBikeWorld (2024 D5 Pro review) says Class 3: 20 mph on throttle, 28 mph with pedal assist; maker's '20+' is consistent but doesn't confirm the out-of-box assist limit. wBW says the D5 Pro was formerly called the Zebra Pro and identifies the motor as a Bafang (probably M560/M600). wBW range figure is from aggressive off-road riding; it reports ~65 miles on pavement at PAS 1. | recheck: Himiway's own 'Unlock the Limit of the Speed' page says its e-bikes ship as Class 2 (unlockable to 25 mph) and lists this model's unlock video; 1 WebSearch used for the Himiway set. This contradicts webBikeWorld's Class 3. Upway has no D5 Pro listing.
